articles.summary: Company Issues Statement in Response to Starboard Knife River Corporation (NYSE: KNF) (“Knife River” or the “Company”) issued the following statement in response to the letter it received today from Starboard Value LP and certain of its affiliates (“Starboard”): The Knife River Board of Directors (the “Board”) and management team welcome input from shareholders and are always open to constructive dialogue in the interest of enhancing shareholder value. The Company first learned of Starboard’s investment on September 22, 2026, and will engage with them to better understand their views. The Board and management regularly review all opportunities to create value for shareholders and will continue to act in the best interests of the Company and its shareholders. The Board is confident Knife River has the experienced leadership and operating discipline required to navigate the current market environment and capitalize on the opportunities ahead. Since becoming an independent public company
articles.title: Knife River Reiterates Focus on Disciplined Execution and Shareholder Value Creation
